controller: specs/1183-runtime-efficiency-program/evidence/two-host-qualification/cluster-controller.py and api.py, unchanged; series x1 (delay,loop), x2 (loop), x3 (loop)
note: The controller names node logs node-<host>-<n>.log per series, so each series overwrote the previous one: the archive keeps node A's and the sender's x3 logs and the x1 second sender's log (node-b-1.log). Every case ledger and every sender receipt directory is kept.
timing: secondsToSettledReceipt is measured by the controller from writing cancel.json over SSH, through one-second SSH polling for finished.json, to the two SSH reads of finished.json and dispatch.json that follow; it is an approximate measurement (the clock starts just after the request is written and stops after both reads), not a latency. The hook marks its output timingEligible: false.
